candidate.claim: combineURLs strips trailing slashes from baseURL and leading slashes from relativeURL then concatenates without inserting a separator, producing e.g. base+relative without '/'
candidate.title: combineURLs omits '/' separator

verifier.reason: The code at helpers/combineURLs.js:22 returns baseURL.slice(0, end) + relativeURL.replace(/^\/+/, '') with no '/' inserted after trimming trailing slashes at helpers/combineURLs.js:18-20 and leading slashes, so e.g. 'https://x/api/' + '/users' becomes 'https://x/apiusers', and core/buildFullPath.js:73 passes the result through directly.

candidate.claim: buildURL keeps the '#' when stripping the fragment before appending serialized params, so query string is appended after '#' and becomes part of the fragment instead of the query
candidate.title: buildURL appends query after fragment

verifier.reason: At helpers/buildURL.js:63 url.slice(0, hashmarkIndex + 1) retains the '#' character, and helpers/buildURL.js:65 then appends '?/&' plus serializedParams after it, so the params fall inside the fragment rather than the query string.

candidate.claim: transformRequest returns data.buffer for any ArrayBuffer view, discarding byteOffset and byteLength so a subarray/view sends the whole underlying buffer
candidate.title: ArrayBufferView loses offset/length

verifier.reason: The branch at defaults/index.js:70-72 unconditionally returns data.buffer for isArrayBufferView data without applying byteOffset or byteLength, so a subarray or offset view is expanded to its entire underlying buffer.

candidate.claim: createScheduler.start overwrites this.timer with a new setInterval without clearing an existing interval, leaking the previous timer
candidate.title: Scheduler start replaces timer without clear

verifier.reason: The code at helpers/scheduler.js:6-7 assigns this.timer = setInterval(callback, intervalMs) with no prior clearInterval or guard, while helpers/scheduler.js:9-11 stop() can only clear the most recent timer, so a second start() loses the previous interval reference and leaks it.
